checks.title: Unreadable or unresolved information
checks.behavior: Analysis failed, a required candidate field is missing, or source values conflict.

checks.title: Exact duplicate files
checks.behavior: An identical file was imported again; exclude the duplicate from active evidence.

checks.title: Wrong income amount basis
checks.behavior: A prepared gross-pay answer uses source net pay or year-to-date earnings.

checks.title: Evidence period does not match the request
checks.behavior: The confirmed evidence dates do not cover the requested period.

checks.title: Person, program or application does not match
checks.behavior: The evidence and request have incompatible scope; missing context also prevents a positive match.

checks.title: Comparable pay records disagree
checks.behavior: The same person, employer, period and payment date have conflicting gross amounts.

checks.title: Previous balance used as current charges
checks.behavior: A prepared current-charge answer uses total due including an older balance.

checks.title: County request still needs a response
checks.behavior: A confirmed evidence request has no matching response event recorded.

checks.title: Document type unresolved
checks.behavior: The information reader has not established a supported document kind.

relatedWorkflowSafeguards.behavior: Changed information invalidates an earlier confirmed transfer.
Upload receipts and application submission receipts remain distinct.

names: correction resolves issue without changing source or old snapshot
explanation is revision-bound and does not confirm facts
history is not automatically expired by import date
new event invalidates prepared transfer; receipt cannot become submission
delete all copies removes history and dependent events
mixed documents abstain, unsupported model fields and invented quotes rejected
integer cents are stored and updated exactly
known upload receipt cannot be recorded as an application receipt
exact duplicates are excluded; equal amounts in different files survive
partial confirmation keeps unknowns unknown and freezes earlier snapshots
changing one fact preserves other confirmations and invalidates transfers
manual zero is explicit; blank does not become zero
moving history or deleting source removes active answers without mutating snapshots
events require provenance and isolate program and upload status
invalid dates rejected; reports and source receipts remain distinct
extension is separate, no host/content-script/storage permissions
support received is income; paid is expense; unknown direction remains other
person corrections invalidate dependent attribution without rewriting history
four questions and income ranges replace exact amount input
executedDoctorAndStateTests.scope: Doctor and related state tests, including reader validation; not 46 independent issues or applicant cases.

previousFullSuite.scope: Previously recorded full suite. The 46-test run is a subset, not additional tests.

plannedScenarioCatalog.scope: Design scenarios; not claimed as executed or passing.

aiAuthoredScenarioAssessment.scope: Synthetic post-extraction Doctor/state logic assessment. 132 executable scenarios across nine checks and two workflow guards; 26 narrative future scenarios across 13 design patterns. Not document-classifier accuracy or a representative applicant sample.
aiAuthoredScenarioAssessment.origin: AI-authored expectations frozen before first run; implementation-informed and not independently validated.
aiAuthoredScenarioAssessment.relationshipToPreviousTests: Separate scenario assessment with overlapping behaviors; do not add counts to claim unique real-world cases. The original planned 120 entries remain not_run.

boundaries: No complaint prevalence or applicant outcome measured.
Checks are explicit rules, not a model trained on public posts.
Sources collected later are not backdated as original design causes.
Rule checks do not establish eligibility, document authenticity or county acceptance.
